items.title: Geometric Islamic Octagram Star Lattice Vector Panel for CNC
items.description: An elegant vertical privacy panel featuring a traditional Islamic geometric layout with repeating eight-pointed stars (octagrams) and intersecting polygons. The design offers a balanced and seamless mesh effect, combining architectural heritage with functional security.
